## Relation to the 2026-10-05 bid package

The bid package `docs/bid/package/` (technical source `{{HIST_SRC}}`, package commit `{{HIST_PKG}}`) is immutable
evidence of the earlier draft and is not modified. This annexure replaces its technical content (01-04) as the current
technical description. A9.42 sec. 11 deferred this regeneration until DBF-1.2 was frozen, and the owner directed it on
2026-10-10. The programmatic skeletons (`05_PROGRAMMATIC_SECTIONS.md`) and the Part IV(A)-(H) submission checklist
(`06_SUBMISSION_CHECKLIST.md`) of that package do not depend on the design and are not regenerated here. When the
owner assembles the upload set, the checklist's file references point to the A1-A4 files below.
